Animation.description:
An ordered, finite timeline over the shared canvas and palette (ADR-032).

``loop_count`` is the playback repetition count (``0``: infinite playback); it
never multiplies what is rendered. ``pivot`` is the common integer anchor of
every frame, in canvas pixels (``0..width`` by ``0..height``).
Animation.title: Animation

Canvas.description: Canvas size and colour profile (``strict`` or ``rgba``, MOANA.md section 9).
Canvas.title: Canvas

Color.description: A palette entry; ``rgba`` is ``#RRGGBBAA`` and is stored upper-case.
Color.title: Color

DitherOperation.description:
Ordered Bayer dithering of the pixels of mask ``mask_id`` (ADR-025).

Pixel ``(x, y)`` of the mask takes ``color_b`` when
``M[(y - oy) mod size][(x - ox) mod size] < coverage`` (mathematical modulo,
``origin = [ox, oy]``) and ``color_a`` otherwise; nothing outside the mask is
drawn. ``coverage`` is an integer in ``0..size^2``.
DitherOperation.title: DitherOperation

EllipseMask.description: Mask of the ellipse inscribed in a half-open box (same rule as ``ellipse``).
EllipseMask.title: EllipseMask

EllipseOperation.description: Ellipse inscribed in a half-open box, by pixel-centre inclusion.
EllipseOperation.title: EllipseOperation

Frame.description: One frame: a stable ID, a whole duration in milliseconds and its overrides.
Frame.title: Frame

Layer.description:
Ordered operations drawn bottom-to-top; ``locked`` affects editing only.

``mask_id`` (optional) clips the whole layer to a semantic mask (ADR-022).
Layer.title: Layer

Light.description:
Discrete artistic light of a ``shade`` operation (MOANA.md section 9, ADR-028).

``direction``: eight picture-plane orientations or ``front``; ``height`` ``0..3``
(0 grazes the plane, 3 faces the viewer; unused by ``front``); ``intensity``: ramp
steps between a facing that looks at the light and the ambient step;
``ambient``: ramp index of an unexposed facing. No normal is inferred.
Light.title: Light

LineMask.description: Mask of a one-pixel line, inclusive at both ends (same rule as ``line``).
LineMask.title: LineMask

LineOperation.description: One-pixel line, inclusive at both ends (MOANA.md section 6).
LineOperation.title: LineOperation

MaterialOperation.description:
Band shading of ramp ``ramp`` with the texture of a versioned preset (ADR-030).

The bands, ``light`` and ``ramp_order`` behave exactly as in ``shade``
(ADR-028); then each pixel moves by the ramp-step offset of its texture cell
(:mod:`moana.techniques.materials`), and the index is clamped to the ramp again.
``(preset, version)`` names a recipe of :data:`moana.core.materials.MATERIAL_PRESETS`
(``unknown_preset_version``), whose row bounds ``density`` (sixty-fourths) and
``scale`` (cell side). ``origin`` anchors the cells on the canvas. No code,
formula or shader is read from the document.
MaterialOperation.title: MaterialOperation

Metadata.description: Descriptive metadata; it never changes the rendered pixels.
Metadata.title: Metadata

OutlineOperation.description:
Outline of mask ``mask_id``, ``width`` pixels wide, painted with ``color`` (ADR-027).

``side`` ``outer`` paints ``dilate(mask, width) - mask`` and ``inner`` paints
``mask - erode(mask, width)``, with the Chebyshev neighbourhood and a transparent
exterior (MOANA.md section 8). ``width`` is an integer in ``1..16``.
OutlineOperation.title: OutlineOperation

Palette.description: Palette with stable colour IDs and optional authored ramps.
Palette.title: Palette

PathMask.description: Mask of a fixed-point path filled by ``aggdraw-v1`` (same rule as ``path``).
PathMask.title: PathMask

PathOperation.description:
Nonzero fill of a fixed-point path by the ``aggdraw-v1`` backend (ADR-023).

Coverage at native scale is binarised (``>= 128``); subpaths close implicitly.
PathOperation.title: PathOperation

PixelMask.description: Mask of exactly one pixel at ``at`` (canvas coordinates, ADR-022).
PixelMask.title: PixelMask

PolygonMask.description: Mask of an even-odd filled polygon (same rule as ``polygon``).
PolygonMask.title: PolygonMask

PolygonOperation.description: Even-odd filled polygon of at least three vertices.
PolygonOperation.title: PolygonOperation

Ramp.description: Ordered colour IDs from shadow to light; at least two distinct entries.
Ramp.title: Ramp

RectMask.description: Mask of a filled half-open box ``[x0, y0, x1, y1)``.
RectMask.title: RectMask

RectOperation.description: Filled half-open box ``[x0, y0, x1, y1)``.
RectOperation.title: RectOperation

Region.description:
Semantic region: a stable ID bound to a mask and, optionally, operations.

It lets an agent target "the left eye" by ID instead of inferring pixels.
Region.title: Region

SelectiveOutlineOperation.description:
Outline of mask ``mask_id`` whose segments take ramp steps from the light (ADR-030).

The ring is that of ``outline`` (``width``, ``side``, ADR-027). A ring pixel inside
a ``segments`` mask takes ``ramp[band_index(facing, offset, light)]`` of the last
listed segment that contains it (the ``shade`` rule of ADR-028, not a second light
rule); every other ring pixel takes ``color``. 1 to 64 segments.
SelectiveOutlineOperation.title: SelectiveOutlineOperation

SetColorOverride.description: Point an operation at another palette colour in one frame (ADR-032).
SetColorOverride.title: SetColorOverride

SetVisibilityOverride.description: Show or hide a layer in one frame (ADR-032).
SetVisibilityOverride.title: SetVisibilityOverride

ShadeBand.description:
One authored band: mask ``mask_id``, its ``facing`` and an ``offset`` in steps.

The ID is global like any other; ``facing`` is a light direction or ``none``.
ShadeBand.title: ShadeBand

ShadeOperation.description:
Band shading with colours of ramp ``ramp`` chosen by index (ADR-028).

Each band paints ``ramp[clamp(ambient + level + offset)]`` over its mask, with
``level`` from the band ``facing`` and the ``light``; where bands overlap the last
listed wins. ``ramp_order`` ``monotonic`` reports a render warning when the ramp
luminance does not grow; ``stylized`` documents the exception. 1 to 64 bands.
ShadeOperation.title: ShadeOperation

SubtractMask.description: Pixels of the first operand that are in none of the others.
SubtractMask.title: SubtractMask

TranslateOverride.description: Move an operation or mask leaf by whole pixels in one frame (ADR-032).
TranslateOverride.title: TranslateOverride

UnionMask.description: Pixels of at least one operand.
UnionMask.title: UnionMask

XorMask.description: Pixels of an odd number of operands.
XorMask.title: XorMask

description: Structural schema of a Moana sprite document. validate_document also rejects duplicate member names, NaN/Infinity, documents over 8 MiB, deeper than 32 or with more than 20000 nodes, repeated IDs, unknown color references, more than 10000 operations, strict-profile violations (alpha other than 00/FF, layer opacity other than 255, more than 256 colors), unknown or repeated mask, region and operation references, mask reference cycles and mask reference chains longer than 16.
title: Moana document 1.0
